BERNOULLI AND EULER POLYNOMIALS, RIEMANN ZETA FUNCTION (p.805)
Integrals
23.1.11  [left] \int_a^x B_n(t)dt=\dfrac{B_{n+1}(x)-B_{n+1}(a)}{n+1}   |   [right] \int_a^x E_n(t)dt=\dfrac{E_{n+1}(x)-E_{n+1}(a)}{n+1}
23.1.12  [left] \int_0^1 B_n(t)B_m(t)dt=(-1)^{n-1}\dfrac{m!n!}{(m+n)!}B_{m+n}\quad m,n=1,2,\ldots   |   [right] \int_0^1 E_n(t)E_m(t)dt=(-1)^n4(2^{m+n+2}-1)\dfrac{m!n!}{(m+n+2)!}B_{m+n+2}\quad m,n=0,1,\ldots
(The polynomials are orthogonal for m+n odd.)
Inequalities
23.1.13  [left] |B_{2n}|>|B_{2n}(x)|\quad n=1,2,\ldots,\ 1>x>0   |   [right] 4^{-n}|E_{2n}|>(-1)^nE_{2n}(x)>0\quad n=1,2,\ldots,\ \tfrac12>x>0
23.1.14  [left] \dfrac{2(2n+1)!}{(2\pi)^{2n+1}}\Big(\dfrac{1}{1-2^{-2n}}\Big)>(-1)^{n+1}B_{2n+1}(x)>0\quad n=1,2,\ldots,\ \tfrac12>x>0   |   [right] \dfrac{4(2n-1)!}{\pi^{2n}}\Big(1+\dfrac{1}{2^{2n}-2}\Big)>(-1)^nE_{2n-1}(x)>0\quad n=1,2,\ldots,\ \tfrac12>x>0
23.1.15  [left] \dfrac{2(2n)!}{(2\pi)^{2n}}\Big(\dfrac{1}{1-2^{1-2n}}\Big)>(-1)^{n+1}B_{2n}>\dfrac{2(2n)!}{(2\pi)^{2n}}\quad n=1,2,\ldots   |   [right] \dfrac{4^{n+1}(2n)!}{\pi^{2n+1}}>(-1)^nE_{2n}>\dfrac{4^{n+1}(2n)!}{\pi^{2n+1}}\Big(\dfrac{1}{1+3^{-1-2n}}\Big)\quad n=0,1,\ldots
Fourier Expansions
23.1.16  [left] B_n(x)=-2\dfrac{n!}{(2\pi)^n}\sum_{k=1}^\infty\dfrac{\cos(2\pi kx-\frac12\pi n)}{k^n}\quad n>1,1\ge x\ge0;\ n=1,1>x>0   |   [right] E_n(x)=4\dfrac{n!}{\pi^{n+1}}\sum_{k=0}^\infty\dfrac{\sin((2k+1)\pi x-\frac12\pi n)}{(2k+1)^{n+1}}\quad n>0,1\ge x\ge0;\ n=0,1>x>0
23.1.17  [left] B_{2n-1}(x)=\dfrac{(-1)^n2(2n-1)!}{(2\pi)^{2n-1}}\sum_{k=1}^\infty\dfrac{\sin2k\pi x}{k^{2n-1}}\quad n>1,1\ge x\ge0;\ n=1,1>x>0   |   [right] E_{2n-1}(x)=\dfrac{(-1)^n4(2n-1)!}{\pi^{2n}}\sum_{k=0}^\infty\dfrac{\cos(2k+1)\pi x}{(2k+1)^{2n}}\quad n=1,2,\ldots,\ 1\ge x\ge0
23.1.18  [left] B_{2n}(x)=\dfrac{(-1)^{n-1}2(2n)!}{(2\pi)^{2n}}\sum_{k=1}^\infty\dfrac{\cos2k\pi x}{k^{2n}}\quad n=1,2,\ldots,\ 1\ge x\ge0   |   [right] E_{2n}(x)=\dfrac{(-1)^n4(2n)!}{\pi^{2n+1}}\sum_{k=0}^\infty\dfrac{\sin(2k+1)\pi x}{(2k+1)^{2n+1}}\quad n>0,1\ge x\ge0;\ n=0,1>x>0
Special Values
23.1.19  [left] B_{2n+1}=0\quad n=1,2,\ldots   |   [right] E_{2n+1}=0\quad n=0,1,\ldots
23.1.20  [left] B_n(0)=(-1)^nB_n(1)=B_n\quad n=0,1,\ldots   |   [right] E_n(0)=-E_n(1)=-2(n+1)^{-1}(2^{n+1}-1)B_{n+1}\quad n=1,2,\ldots
23.1.21  [left] B_n(\tfrac12)=-(1-2^{1-n})B_n\quad n=0,1,\ldots   |   [right] E_n(\tfrac12)=2^{-n}E_n\quad n=0,1,\ldots
